title: Air-Stable Solid-State Photoluminescence Standards for Quantitative Measurements Based on 4′-Phenyl-2,2′:6′,2′′-Terpyridine Complexes with Trivalent Lanthanides

synthesis.procedure: Variant A (preferred small-scale bulk): Eu(OAc)3·xH2O (65.8 mg, 0.2 mmol, calculated as monohydrate) and ptpy (46.4 mg, 0.15 mmol) were placed in a Duran culture tube with 4 mL MeCN and stirred at 100 °C for 16 h. The tube was centrifuged (4000 rpm, 12 min), solvent removed with a syringe, and the white, intensely red-luminescent powder isolated (yield 90.1 mg, 93%). Variant B (upscaled, SI): analogous 1 mmol-scale culture-tube reaction gave 429 mg (89%). Variant C: Eu(OAc)3·xH2O (329 mg, 1 mmol) and ptpy (232 mg, 0.75 mmol) in 50 mL MeCN under reflux for 3 days; filtered, washed with MeCN (50 mL) and CHCl3 (2×30 mL), dried in air (319 mg, 66%). Single crystals: ~2 mg of an impure 2-Eu reaction mixture sealed with MeCN (0.2 mL) in an ampoule and heated at 140 °C for 16 h.

properties.summary: Solid-state Eu3+ 4f–4f photoluminescence after ligand-centred UV excitation; proposed air-stable PLQY standard (humidity-stable to 75% RH). Absolute solid-state PLQY 58(4)% (headline), with independent setups giving 57.9(3.9)% (setup I) and 61.8(1)% (setup II). Monoexponential lifetime 1.71(5) ms independent of λex/λem despite two crystallographic Eu sites. Individual 4f–4f PLQY contributions reported in Table 1.

synthesis.procedure: Variant A: Tb(OAc)3·xH2O (67.2 mg, 0.2 mmol, calculated as monohydrate) and ptpy (32.5 mg, 0.105 mmol) in a Duran culture tube with 4 mL MeCN, stirred at 50 °C for 16 h; centrifuged (4000 rpm, 12 min), solvent removed, washed with CHCl3 (2×3 mL), dried under vacuum at 50 °C for 20 min, stored in a glovebox. White powder with intense green luminescence, yield 83.0 mg (85%). Variant B: 336 mg Tb(OAc)3·xH2O (1 mmol) and 232 mg ptpy (0.75 mmol) with 4 mL MeCN in a culture tube (upscaled analog of variant A); yield 405 mg (83%). Variant C: Tb(OAc)3·xH2O (336 mg, 1 mmol) and ptpy (232 mg, 0.75 mmol) in 50 mL MeCN, reflux 3 days; filtered, washed with MeCN and CHCl3, air-dried (351 mg, 71%).

synthesis.procedure: Ln(OAc)3·xH2O (Eu: 65.8 mg, 0.2 mmol as monohydrate) and ptpy (32.5 mg, 0.105 mmol) in a Duran culture tube with MeCN (2 mL) and H2O (20 µL), stirred at 70 °C for 16 h. Centrifuged (4000 rpm, 12 min), solvent removed, washed with MeCN (2 mL) and CHCl3 (2×3 mL), dried under vacuum at room temperature for 20 min. White powder with intense red luminescence, yield 88.5 mg (90%). Single crystals: ~2 mg impure 2-Eu mixture sealed with MeCN (0.2 mL), heated at 80 °C for 382 h (Büchi B-585).

synthesis.procedure: 2-Eu (64.0 mg, 0.032 mmol) was placed in a glass tube on a vacuum-line quick-fit and heated in vacuo (1×10−3 mbar) at 60 °C for 16 h. Product stored in a glovebox. White powder with intense red luminescence, yield 57.7 mg (92%). Reversible rehydration to 2-Eu is noted in the main text. Structure from Rietveld refinement of powder data (CCDC 2164887).

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Solid-state dehydration; glovebox storage. No recrystallization.
